Interface IAnimatedBlock

All Known Subinterfaces:
IAnimatedBlockSpigot
All Known Implementing Classes:
AnimatedBlockDisplay, AnimatedHighlightedBlock
public interface IAnimatedBlock
Represents a block that is being animated.

    • getCurrentPosition

      Vector3Dd getCurrentPosition()
      Returns the current position of this animated block.

      This value is updated after each tick/teleport.

      Returns:
      The current position of this animated block.

    • getPreviousPosition

      Vector3Dd getPreviousPosition()
      Gets the previous position of this animated block.

      This value is updated after each tick/teleport and describes the location this animated block was at before it moved.

      Returns:
      The previous position of this animated block.

    • getPreviousTarget

      Vector3Dd getPreviousTarget()
      Gets the previous movement target.

      This value is updated after each tick/teleport and describes the target this animated block was moving towards before it moved.

      Returns:
      The previous movement target.

    • getWorld

      IWorld getWorld()
      Gets the world this animated block exists in.
      Returns:
      The world this animated block exists in.

    • moveToTarget

      void moveToTarget(RotatedPosition target)
      Moves this animated block to the target.

      The movement will be applied during the next tick.

      Parameters:
      target - The target position the block should move to.
